text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... My body is totally worn out~.
We ran so, so much after all~.
choice_data_list: Good work today. You really worked hard out there.
Good work today. You tried your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
You really did a fantastic job!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, did I
really get stronger than before, do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I definitely got stronger, right?
I mean, I worked super hard after all.
choice_data_list: Let's put it to the test in the race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! You're right!
Yeah, I'll do my best in the next race!

And so, our fulfilling summer training camp
with Haru Urara came to an end...
